mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_items ( user_id, plan_item_id, source_execution_item_id, title, description, placement_type, scheduled_date, scheduled_start_at, scheduled_end_at, expected_minutes, status, priority, order_index, routine_id, origin_type, modified_after_creation, version, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{planItemId}, #{sourceExecutionItemId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{placementType}, #{scheduledDate}, #{scheduledStartAt}, #{scheduledEndAt}, #{expectedMinutes}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{orderIndex}, #{routineId}, #{originType}, #{modifiedAfterCreation}, #{version}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM execution_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'PLANNED' AND scheduled_date IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_date < #{baseDate} ORDER BY scheduled_date ASC, scheduled_start_at ASC, execution_item_id ASC
